rows.backtranslation: Colour #%1$s. Tap to choose foreground colour. Press and hold to choose background colour.
rows.context_and_review_note: Revised the hold clause from finite second-person tṭṭfḍ to the imperative ṭṭf after sit: Press, hold to choose background. This matches the imperative tap instruction and avoids an unintroduced finite coordination. Full contextual foreground/background names retained. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:615 receives raw six-digit hex, WITHOUT #; the translation therefore keeps exactly one literal # before %1$s. :618 uses setColour(colour,false) on tap and :619 true on long press. This raw-hex swatch must not be confused with ColourStatusButton.hex, which already returns #. No automatic colour inversion or document background repaint is implied.

rows.backtranslation: Colour palette. Tap for foreground, press and hold for background. Move the palette to see more colours.
rows.context_and_review_note: Applied the same imperative hold correction as the swatch description. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:604 labels the HorizontalScrollView whose children are the colour swatches. Move the palette to see more colours is a functional scroll instruction in this container, not colour reordering or canvas movement. No unsupported direction gesture is specified. The full explanation is long but is an accessibility description rather than a compact visible caption; screen-reader verbosity and gesture comprehension have not been tested.

Retained amzwaru, the foreground qualifier from the existing complete label, as a contextual short caption. It is not presented as a conventional two-letter acronym. ColourStatusButton.kt:61 uses it beside the hex value; :68 shrinks the whole horizontal caption to available width without a lower text-size limit. The vertical branch :46–55 instead centres measured bounds at fixed 11sp, with NO fitting/shrinking. Therefore linguistic retention does not certify readability or fit, particularly in vertical mode and at large font scales. Separate full accessibility target descriptions remain at :35–36.

Retained amdfir, the matching background qualifier, rather than inventing a Latin or Tifinagh acronym. Same ColourStatusButton horizontal/vertical rendering limitations as ui_fg: horizontal shrinking can make text too small; vertical centring does not guarantee containment. The independent full background accessibility description remains available. No claim of native-established abbreviations or rendered-fit success is made.
